days.reviewer: Claude (Opus 5.5), visual review against source pixels
days.note: Header read off the graphic: SET TIMES, three columns per stage headed FRI 24, SAT 25 and SUN 26, each stage "(Listed by set time)". The year is not printed on the set-times section; the graphic is the one the 2017 lineup page embedded (Wayback capture 20170320152917), and March 24, 25 and 26 fall on Friday to Sunday in 2017. Every set prints a start only, so every row is open-ended. Stage names are the stage logos, uppercased; ULTRA MAINSTAGE is recorded as ULTRA MAIN STAGE, the name its later grids print. The third stage prints carl cox MEGASTRUCTURE with RESISTANCE on Friday and Saturday and the A State of Trance logo on Sunday, and is one stage, MEGASTRUCTURE. The fourth prints RESISTANCE with ARCADIA THE SPIDER (SPACE ON TOUR over Saturday) and is recorded as ARCADIA THE SPIDER. The fifth is ULTRA WORLDWIDE, recorded as WORLDWIDE STAGE. Names are kept as printed, including presents lines. Blurred white-and-yellow bars stand where a block was not yet announced; they print no name or time and are left out. Each ARCADIA LANDING SHOW row is the stage show, printed between sets; the show-segment rule drops it at build. Friday leaves out 1 blurred bar on LIVE STAGE and 2 on OASIS. On BISCAYNE a separate line FEAT. MC CONCEPT prints below MERLYN B2B SUPERNAUT with a gap and no time of its own; the set is recorded as MERLYN B2B SUPERNAUT and the line is noted here.
